question: In which stadium was the final match of ODI Cricket World Cup 2011 played?
solution:
The correct answer is **Wankhede Stadium**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The final match** of the ODI Cricket World Cup 2011 was played at Wankhede Stadium, Mumbai.
 
• **India and Sri Lanka** faced each other in the final match.
 
• **India won** the match, securing its second World Cup title after the first win in 1983.
 
• **MS Dhoni** was the captain of the Indian cricket team, and his performance was pivotal in leading India to victory.
 
• **The match is memorable** for MS Dhoni's winning six, clinching the victory for India.
